svg.title: Padding and stride change the number of filter placements
svg.desc: Three copies of a seven-by-seven input with a three-by-three filter. Without padding at stride one there are five placements per axis; one ring of zero padding restores the lost border placements and gives seven; stride two on the unpadded input takes every other placement and gives three.
svg.text: a 3 × 3 filter on a 7 × 7 input: every valid placement outlined
